title: Unreal Engine development
summary: Works on Unreal projects: C++ and Blueprint-backed classes, command-line builds and packaging with an engine its owner installed.

role.title: Unreal developer
role.for: Unreal Engine projects: C++ gameplay code, building and packaging from the command line
role.brief: Match the engine version the .uproject names. Build and package with the engine's own command-line tools, and read their log rather than their exit code alone.

skills: Gameplay classes derive from AActor or ACharacter with UCLASS/UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION macros; the header and source live in Source/<Project>/.
Binaries/, Intermediate/, Saved/ and DerivedDataCache/ are generated and never edited.

knowledge.title: Unreal Engine API for the project's version

requires.why: compiles, checks and packages the project

conventions: Generated folders are never edited or committed

limits: Sign in to Epic Games or accept the Unreal Engine EULA on its owner's behalf
